verdict.rationale: Zero's repo ships a first-party AGENT.md file aimed at coding agents. It lists commands such as quick start, AI tests and the eval suite, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for working on the codebase. The MCP.md tool list belongs to the separate MCP-server story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: any llms.txt, agent-oriented docs covering product usage rather than contributor dev commands, evidence of how deep or how maintained AGENT.md is, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
